visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large, well-groomed white and orange tabby cat is sitting upright on a white desk surface. A human hand enters from the bottom right to gently stroke the cat's chin. The background is a clean, bright indoor room with soft, diffused lighting. Prominent yellow and black text overlays the center of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a man with short hair and glasses, wearing a dark grey shirt, sitting in a home office environment filled with computer monitors and recording gear. He holds a white smartphone over an orange cat that is lying on its back on the desk. Bright red and blue stylized text appears on screen. (3) The camera shows several close-up views of a wall-mounted spiral calendar titled "2026 FUMEANCATS CALENDAR". The pages are being flipped by an unseen hand, showcasing high-resolution photographs of different cats in various humorous and professional poses, such as one cat wearing miniature round sunglasses and another biting a feather brush. (4) A hand is seen flipping through the pages of a smaller desk calendar. The calendar features a clean white layout with a large cat photo on one side and a monthly grid on the other. Each page includes specific "Lazy Living" tips in Chinese text. The setting is a warm wooden tabletop. (5) A person's hands hold and open a mint-green "2026 SCHEDULE DIARY" that has several colorful cartoon cat illustrations on the cover. As the pages turn, they reveal large, full-page color photos of real cats alongside organized monthly planning spreads. The background remains the same wooden desk. (6) A fast-paced montage displays various branded merchandise. This includes a close-up of a shiny gold coin with a cat emblem, a yellow handheld sticker machine being used to apply round cat stickers to a notebook, a cat-head-shaped stack of sticky notes, and a small black stamp leaving a cat-themed checklist on a yellow post-it note. (7) The video shows a person wearing a black graphic t-shirt with a "KEEP COOL" slogan and a picture of a cat in sunglasses. It then switches to a close-up of another white t-shirt featuring a grid of twelve different stylized cat portraits in a colorful pop-art style. (8) The original white and orange tabby cat returns to the screen, sitting calmly in the same studio setting. It looks directly at the camera and opens its mouth wide in a large meow. A final graphic appears with the brand logo and social media handle.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator initiates the audio track with a highly energetic, bright, and enthusiastic vocal delivery, typical of promotional content. Simultaneously, an upbeat acoustic-pop background music track begins, featuring a steady, driving tempo of approximately 120 BPM with prominent acoustic guitar strumming and a light percussion bed. (2) The narrator's tone shifts slightly towards a more inquisitive and playful inflection as he asks rhetorical questions. The vocal pitch exhibits high variability to maintain viewer engagement. The BGM remains constant in the background, providing a cheerful and cohesive atmosphere. No significant background noise is present, indicating high-quality studio recording. (3) As the narration moves into describing specific product features, the speech rate remains fast and rhythmic. The narrator uses clear articulation to list the calendar's contents. The background music continues with its major-key tonality and steady beat, perfectly complementing the positive and informative nature of the verbal descriptions. (4) The audio mix introduces several distinct, sharp post-production sound effects. Each time a product is demonstrated visually, such as a stamp being pressed or a sticker dispenser being clicked, a corresponding "click," "thud," or "pop" sound effect is synchronized. These SFX have short spectral bandwidth and high transient intensity. (5) The narrator continues to deliver sales-oriented copy with a persuasive and friendly tone. The vocal energy remains high-arousal throughout the segment. The interaction between the voice and the music is well-balanced, with the vocals sitting clearly on top of the instrumental mix. No external environmental noise is audible. (6) In the final phase, the narrator emphasizes a call to action with increased vocal projection. A loud, sharp, and natural cat meow is heard, which is high-pitched and has a wide spectral range. This is followed by a final musical chord that resolves the BGM as the audio fades into silence.
